title: Meta names Assaf Keren, a former chief security officer at Qualtrics and a former CISO at PayPal, as its next CISO, succeeding Guy Rosen, who will leave in 2026 (Riley Griffin/Bloomberg)
summary: Riley Griffin / Bloomberg: Meta names Assaf Keren, a former chief security officer at Qualtrics and a former CISO at PayPal, as its next CISO, succeeding Guy Rosen, who will leave in 2026 — Meta Platforms Inc. tapped a veteran cybersecurity executive to serve as its next chief information security officer …
